n: 7.3 Cu. Ft. Ultra Large Capacity Rear Control Gas Dryer With Easyload™ Door And Ai Sensing
desc: Discover the ultimate convenience in drying with the LG gas dryer, featuring a generous 7.3-cu. ft. ultra-large capacity. Engineered for efficiency and ease, this dryer is equipped with LG EasyLoad door technology, revolutionizing how you tackle laundry day.
hl: Built-in Intelligence Takes Out The Guesswork

Forget about endless sorting or toggling through cycles—built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture and load size, then automatically select the right drying motions and temperatures for advanced fabric care.
Run the dryer whenever you want, without interrupting naptime or your favorite show.
When you hate wrinkles but can’t be there to remove clothes as soon as they’re dry, just select the Wrinkle Care option before hitting start.

Free up your day—fit more clothes in every load with 7.3 cu. ft. of space.
